sample_unit: clinician survey responses (plus 27 clinician interviews, 19 patient surveys, 4 patient interviews)

links.outcome: Clinician-reported contexts where AI scribe use may harm patient care, engagement or be contraindicated
links.effect: Clinicians reported AI scribe use needs careful consideration in certain contexts and may be contraindicated for patients with persecutory delusions involving surveillance (qualitative).
links.quote: They also highlighted that, in certain contexts, the use of AI scribes requires careful consideration to ensure patient care and engagement are maintained and that use with some patients (i.e., those experiencing persecutory delusions involving surveillance) may be contraindicated.

screen.reason: Mixed-methods empirical evaluation of clinician acceptance and patient acceptability of an ambient AI scribe deployed in hospital allied health settings, though it does not formally test a specific safeguard/practice comparator.
